paras: Alcock's toad-headed agama (Phrynocephalus euptilopus), is a species of agamid lizard found in Pakistan and Afghanistan. The species was originally established based on just 6 specimens from Darband, Western Baluchistan. Only preserved specimens are currently on file with the last occurrence in July 1993.
